title: Creamy Crispy Chili Tofu
style: Curry-spiced baked tofu tossed in a creamy, fiery bang bang sauce with crispy chilli oil, served over rice
description: Torn tofu coated in curry powder, cornstarch and soy, baked until crisp, then tossed in a creamy sauce of vegan skyr, mayo, sriracha and crispy chilli oil. Served over rice — about 550 kcal and 24 g protein per serving.
steps: Prep the tofu: Break the tofu into bite-sized pieces by hand. Toss with half of the curry powder and half of the cornstarch.
Coat: Add the soy sauce and mix well, then fold in the remaining curry powder and cornstarch until the tofu is evenly coated.
Bake: Bake in a fan oven at 180°C for about 20 minutes, turning occasionally so it crisps evenly. An air fryer also works — check it early, as times vary.
Sauce: Mix the vegan skyr alternative, vegan mayonnaise, sriracha, crispy chilli oil, salt, garlic powder and soy milk until smooth.
Toss: Add the crispy tofu to the sauce and toss until coated.
Serve straight away over rice, topped with sesame seeds and chives if you like.
tips: Tearing the tofu rather than cutting it gives more rough edges to crisp up.
Toss the tofu in the sauce at the last minute so it stays crunchy.
Start with less salt in the sauce — the soy and chilli oil are already salty.
Adapted from vegan-high-protein.com (crispy bang bang tofu).
